subject: [PATCH 0/4] selftests/mm: check large folio results through check_huge() only

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Agreed with Zi Yan that feedback should be provided on the related series instead.

2026-10-01.patch_summary: This patch series refactors the mm selftests to use a single function, check_huge(), for checking large folio results. The existing functions, check_huge_anon() and check_huge_file(), are merged into check_huge(). Additionally, is_range_backed_by_order() is made an internal function of vm_util.c.
